events.summary: Fiserv said BankSouth will use Finxact for a phased core modernization, strengthening its bank-channel position.
The FDIC is floating a standards body for bank-fintech oversight, but it remains a conceptual idea rather than policy.
The CFPB is reconsidering Section 1033 economics and may allow data aggregators to be charged for consumer data access.
The CFPB's revised open-banking rule has moved deeper into White House review and remains active.
The CFPB will stop publicly posting unverified complaint narratives and related visualizations.
Plaid released an August product update adding identity verification, bank linking, onboarding, and fraud features.
Alkami expanded its Plaid integration to add account linking, financial visibility, and enriched transaction data in digital banking.
Fiserv said it is partnering with Cognition to use Devin AI for core banking modernization.
FinCEN finalized a rule ending beneficial ownership reporting for U.S. companies and persons, retaining limited reporting for some foreign companies.
FDX launched standards work for safe financial data sharing with agentic AI, raising expectations for consent, identity, and audit controls.
CFPB recognized FDX as the first standard-setting body for open banking, increasing its influence on the rule environment.
CFPB said it will stop publishing unverified complaint narratives and visualizations.
Plaid and Sierra partnered to embed secure bank account linking inside AI agent conversations.
Fiserv partnered with Cognition to use Devin AI for core banking modernization.

events.summary: The CFPB’s Section 1033 open-banking rewrite moved back into active rulemaking, with a new proposal to OIRA and an interim final rule expected.
Socure expanded its identity and fraud stack through partnerships with Checkr Trust and Thomson Reuters.
Q2 rolled out an AI assistant and Q2 Code, an AI-enabled development environment for digital-banking extensions.
Personetics launched an MCP server enabling agentic AI on customer financial data; also announced a deposit-growth collaboration with Atomic.
Personetics launched an MCP server so banks can build agentic AI applications on top of its customer financial-intelligence data.
Nymbus announced a secure MCP server to let AI agents perform core banking actions.
Flybits introduced an agentic banking capability to orchestrate AI-guided customer journeys inside digital banking channels.
Fiserv said it has co-created AI agents with six banks and OpenAI, extending its agentOS-style push.
FinCEN and banking agencies proposed updated AML/CFT program rules that raise compliance expectations for banks and money services businesses.
